entities.name: Nikollë Bojaxhiu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nikollë Bojaxhiu, also known as Nikola Bojaxhiu was an Ottoman Albanian businessman, benefactor, politician and the father of the Roman Catholic nun and missionary Mother Teresa. His company constructed the first theatre in Skopje and participated in the development of the railway line connecting Kosovo with Skopje—a project he personally financed.
